# Rate index fixings (`rate-fixing` v1)

Published overnight and term rate fixings (SOFR, €STR, SONIA…).

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `FIX` · **Identifiers:** `FIX-…` in `indexId`

Open one with `FIX <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: rate-fixing
version: 1
description: "Published overnight and term rate fixings (SOFR, €STR, SONIA…)."
match: { kind: rate-fixing, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Rate index fixings, id: $.indexId }
strip:
  - { label: Index, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Latest, bind: $.latest, fmt: pct4, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Administrator, bind: $.administrator }
  - { label: Tenor, bind: $.tenor }
panels:
  - id: fixings
    kind: ladder
    title: Recent fixings
    key: F2
    rows: $.fixings
    columns:
      - { label: Date, bind: "@.date", fmt: date }
      - { label: Rate, bind: "@.rate", fmt: pct4 }
      - { label: Volume (bn), bind: "@.volumeBn", fmt: amount0 }
  - id: chart
    kind: line
    title: Last 30 fixings
    area: right
    rows: $.fixings
    x: date
    y: ratePct
    fmt: price2
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
keys: { F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

## Header fields

|---|---|---|

| Tenor | `$.tenor` | text |
